summary: Ashesi University in Berekuso, Ghana, is a private liberal-arts university known for computer science, engineering and business. Its undergraduate scholarships are need-based, and the strongest awards, including Mastercard Foundation scholarships for African students, cover everything.
meta_description: Ashesi University in Ghana gives need-based scholarships, including full Mastercard Foundation awards for Africans. Application rounds and how to apply.
covers: Need-based scholarships from partial to full, depending on your assessed need.
Mastercard Foundation awards for African students cover all fees, room, board and learning resources.
Mastercard scholars also join a summer leadership programme at the start of the degree.
eligibility: Applicants admitted to an undergraduate programme at Ashesi who can show financial need.
Mastercard Foundation awards are for citizens of African countries.
Ashesi does not give merit scholarships to undergraduates.
how_to_apply: Apply for admission in one of the four rounds: June, August, October or December.
Complete the financial aid form with your application and state how much help you need.
Ashesi places you in a need category and decides which award you receive; you do not choose the award.
Apply early: within each category, funds go to the strongest applications until they run out for that round.
watch_out: You cannot apply for a scholarship after you have been admitted, so apply for aid with your admission application.
Admission decisions are made separately from scholarship decisions.
Ashesi gives months, not exact dates, for each round; confirm the date with admissions@ashesi.edu.gh.
